microcopy.text: Picking an high tier class won't make you auto-win, but it will increases your success odds while learning. The best hero is still the one you enjoy.

philosophyQuotes.text: Tier lists start to make sense once you play ranked. Before that, you can perform well with any hero, any class at max potential is playable. This tierlist shows average strength ... in AVERAGE, a player will performe better with higher tier classes.
Picking an high tier class won't make you auto-win, but it will increases your success odds while learning. The best hero is still the one you enjoy.

generalGuide.text: This thread functions as a cross-hero reference/legend rather than a single-weapon guide: hero runes pointer, recommended Attribute allocation by weapon and armor-weight class, and Armor-stat tier lists by armor-weight class.

weaponSelectionGuide.subtitle: Get an idea of which weapon does what.
weaponSelectionGuide.note: Bastard sword can be placed in recommended and is a easy to play, OP for both hero and units weapons (overall better than sns - even slightly better than poleaxe) there is 'Riposte Build' which is detailed in the guide which is currently (by far) the OP thing in the game.
